datasheet_identity.title: PJM10H01PSA P-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: P-channel values are stored as positive magnitudes; the datasheet prints VDS, ID, VGS, and IS with negative signs where applicable.
Electrical characteristics are specified at Ta = 25 °C unless otherwise stated. RDS(on) rows are pulse-test maximums, not typical values.
The transfer, output, and capacitance curves on p. 3 were digitized from visible plotted traces. Only points within the plotted axes were retained; plotted values are approximate.
The p. 3 transfer panel has 25 °C, 125 °C, and -55 °C traces. The 25 °C trace is the one retained here.
The output panel is labeled VGS = 10 through 5 V and also shows 4 V and 3 V traces. The 5 V and 10 V traces are retained here.

The datasheet publishes Qg = 3.3 nC typical and 4 nC maximum, Qgs = 0.47 nC typical, and Qgd = 1.45 nC typical at the stated switching conditions; these are recorded in this note because the strict schema has no gate-charge field.
IDSS is 100 nA maximum at VDS = -80 V and VGS = 0 V; IGSS is ±100 nA maximum at VGS = ±20 V and VDS = 0 V.
Thermal data include RθJA = 250 °C/W on FR4 with t ≤ 10 s. RθJC is not published.
No reverse-recovery time, gate resistance, or tabulated capacitance test frequency is published in the supplied datasheet.

The supplied PDF has no capacitance table. Its p. 3 C-versus-VDS plot reads approximately Ciss = 0.318 nF and Crss = 0.009 nF at VDS = 100 V, versus the externally reported catalog values 1.25 nF and 1.45 nF at 100 V. The catalog values are not supported by this PJM10H01PSA PDF and are retained only as a discrepancy note, not substituted into the extraction.
omission_reason: No typical threshold, typical RDS(on), or tabulated capacitance values are published. Capacitances are represented by approximate digitized values from the p. 3 C-versus-VDS plot, whose VGS, test frequency, and temperature conditions are not specified. The p. 3 plot is inconsistent with externally reported catalog values of Ciss = 1.25 nF and Crss = 1.45 nF at 100 V; those values are not supported by this PDF and were not substituted. No reverse-recovery time, gate resistance, RθJC, or ID-versus-VGS test-bias value is published.
